scope: Two high-score human white seats reread using current parser vs all64 completed current-policy baseline games from cornerincremental64 (no running holdout scores). Group actual played-card main transactions with immediate triggered rewards; excludes standalone quick steps. Income-track increases separate from immediate grants. Snapshot residuals separate: can span quick steps, not confirmed card cost/return. Historical human missing source/payment data and different companies/versions/seeds prevent causal or overall-efficiency conclusions. AI input parser25 plus exact named pickup correction; does not reconstruct all multi-card gross draws or N/M data numerator. Resource totals descriptive; no static weighted value used to decide policy. Huanyu low/high16 are selected by same-run final score, a descriptive association not a treatment effect.
